sources.title: Gedanken-Experiments on Sequential Machines
sources.enterprise_use: Provides classical prior art for finite deterministic sequential machines, state outputs, and distinguishing internal states by finite experiments/observable behavior. P018 Supplement 18 uses this lineage only to classify future-observation distinguishability and finite state refinement as established automata territory before studying its finite-precision interpretation.
sources.not_claimed: Finite-state observational distinguishability, Moore-machine style behavioral reduction, and sequential-machine minimization are established mathematics/computer science and are not Enterprise Math inventions.

sources.title: Linear automaton transformations
sources.enterprise_use: Provides classical automata/congruence prior art neighboring the use of future-indistinguishability equivalences and minimal quotient representations. P018 does not claim Nerode-style congruence/minimization as new; it studies the exact finite precision-state closure criterion and its interaction with P005/P009/P010/P011/P018.
sources.not_claimed: Nerode equivalence, right-congruence/minimal-automaton ideas, and quotient minimization in automata theory are established and are not Enterprise Math inventions.

sources.title: On the greatest congruence relation contained in an equivalence relation and its applications to the algebraic theory of machines
sources.enterprise_use: Provides direct prior art for the greatest algebra congruence contained in an arbitrary equivalence relation. P018 Supplement 19 uses this established object as the abstract contextual closure of a precision/observation equivalence.
sources.not_claimed: Existence of the greatest congruence contained in an equivalence relation is established universal algebra / machine algebra and is not an Enterprise Math invention.

sources.title: A Course in Universal Algebra
sources.enterprise_use: Provides standard universal-algebra definitions of congruences and quotient algebras. P018 uses this mature algebraic framework when interpreting an operation-closed precision partition as an exact quotient algebra rather than as an approximate numerical state.
sources.not_claimed: Congruence relations, quotient algebras, homomorphism kernels, and standard universal-algebra quotient machinery are established mathematics and are not Enterprise Math inventions.

sources.title: Standard topological algebras: syntactic and principal congruences and profiniteness
sources.enterprise_use: Explicitly formulates Syn(theta) as the largest congruence contained in an equivalence theta and develops term/context tests for syntactic congruences. This is the direct prior-art boundary for P018's multi-ary contextual precision closure and one-hole operation-context refinement.
sources.not_claimed: Syntactic congruence, term-context indistinguishability, and the largest-congruence-inside-equivalence construction are established mathematics and are not Enterprise Math inventions.
